stages: archive recruitment and analysis before new data
search metadata and obtain sealed raw files; export public sequence columns only
report concrete routes; validate implementation and stage2 freeze before unsealing outcomes

required: experimental substitution landscape with multiple mutants
audit shared experiments homologous proteins and prior repository exposure

route_generation_before_data.supported: Within one assay, hash-sort unique sequence IDs with fixed experiment3-v1 namespace; take every fifth row as target, remaining rows as source domain; first 1024 hash-ordered source rows fit, remaining source rows form calibration library. Need >=256 calibration and >=200 target; identify shared order/coverage support without outcomes. This is within-assay transfer and must not be called cross-protein transfer.
route_generation_before_data.extrapolation: For each integer mutation-order cutoff k, source order<=k and target order>k. Eligible k must have >=1280 unique source and >=200 unique target. Select smallest eligible k using counts only; fit first1024 source sequence hashes, remaining source calibration. Report every cutoff count. One extrapolation route per assay.
route_generation_before_data.deduplication: same source and target memberships do not become new routes through seed changes; dependency clusters follow shared proteins/experiments
route_generation_before_data.selection: Inventory all metadata candidates; stage2 panel selection must use prespecified structural eligibility and dependency grouping only. If 20 routes/10 landscapes infeasible, stop; do not weaken budgets or independence definitions.

endpoint.metric: mean(best_trace) difference / frozen source fit IQR
endpoint.matching_failure: fallback Never, retained in all-route analysis

data_firewall.local_protection_boundary: process/code isolation plus file permissions; same local user can technically read vault, not cryptographic independent custody

changes_require_user_decision: weaken recruitment budgets or inflate independent units
